test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Suman paid Rs.9,600 in interest on a loan she obtained 5 years ago with a simple interest rate of 16%. What was the amount of the loan she had taken?
solution:
**Given:**

Suman paid Rs.9,600 in interest on a loan she obtained 5 years ago with a simple interest rate of 16%.

Concept used:

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

P = Sum

T = Time

R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. x

According to the question,

9600 = (x × 16 × 5)/100

⇒ 9600 × 10 = 8x

⇒ x = 96000/8

⇒ x = 12000

So, the sum is Rs. 12000

**∴ The amount of the loan she had taken was Rs. 12,000.**
